## What This Dashboard Answers

The Restaurant at Kellogg Ranch (RKR) is promoted every week in *The Collins Concierge*, the Collins College newsletter. My MSDM culminating project asks:

> **If we change how RKR's section looks, do more readers click through and book a table?**

Before testing any change, we need a baseline. This dashboard shows how the RKR section performed in recent issues.

<a class="cta" href="rkr-dashboard.html">Open the interactive dashboard →</a>

## What You Can Explore

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Overview
Headline numbers and the RKR click rate for each issue, measured against the pooled baseline.

### Audience and Links
Page views per issue, RKR's share of all link clicks, where views came from, and which links readers clicked most.

### Next Tests
The Fall and Spring tests planned for Analytics Objective 1, and the methods that will compare them.

### Data
The issue-level summary behind every chart.

:::

## Key Measures

| Measure | How it is calculated | Why it matters |
|---------|---------------------|----------------|
| Page views | Canva-reported views per issue | Shows how many readers reached the newsletter |
| RKR clicks | Clicks to cpp.edu/rkr pages | The measurable step before booking |
| RKR click rate | RKR clicks ÷ page views | The primary outcome for AO1 |

::: {.callout-note}
## About the data
All numbers come from **Canva website insights** for The Collins Concierge, exported as one CSV per issue for the last 12 weeks. Fourteen exports were received; one byte-identical duplicate was removed, leaving 13 issues. The "Reserve a Table" button links to the RKR website, so clicks to cpp.edu/rkr pages are counted as RKR clicks. Issue dates and OpenTable reservations are not available yet.
:::
